title: Case 044: Emergency Repair Invoice — CLM-044
initial_request: I’m following up on the open claim for 144 Cedar Walk, Brackenford, ZZ5 8ZZ. The emergency repair has been completed, and I’d like help providing the contractor’s invoice to the insurer; so far, I’ve only shared a description of the work.
overview: For the open claim CLM-044, Seb Taylor told Eastmere Risk that emergency repairs at 144 Cedar Walk, Brackenford, ZZ5 8ZZ had been completed and that the broker had only a description of the work. Northmere Mutual Insurance requested the contractor’s invoice; Rachel at Eastmere Risk asked Seb for the invoice rather than a stated total. Seb supplied it, Rachel sent it to the insurer, and the insurer confirmed receipt. That confirmation records receipt of the document only, not cover or payment.

next_action.summary: At the escalation point, Rachel asked Seb to obtain and send the contractor’s invoice, rather than just a figure, then forwarded it to Northmere Mutual Insurance against CLM-044; both steps are recorded as completed, with no further decision implied.

outcome: Northmere Mutual Insurance confirmed that it received the contractor’s invoice for CLM-044; no cover or payment decision is recorded.

events.body: The emergency repair at 144 Cedar Walk, Brackenford, ZZ5 8ZZ has been completed, with the safety arrangements handled separately. I understand you have the description of the work, but not the contractor’s invoice; could you help provide the invoice to the insurer for CLM-044?

For the open claim CLM-044, please send us the contractor’s invoice for the completed emergency repair at 144 Cedar Walk, Brackenford, ZZ5 8ZZ. The work description on file is not the invoice document we requested.

Northmere Mutual Insurance has requested the contractor’s invoice for CLM-044. Please ask the contractor for the invoice itself and send it to me; a description of the work or a total amount alone will not meet this request.

Attached is the contractor’s invoice REP-044, issued 10 August 2025 for emergency repair completed on 9 August at 144 Cedar Walk, Brackenford, ZZ5 8ZZ. Labour £420.00 and materials £264.00 total £684.00; this is an invoice, not a statement that an insurer has agreed to pay.

Please find contractor invoice REP-044, dated 10 August 2025 and totalling £684.00, attached as repair-invoice.png for CLM-044. I am sending it in response to your request; this submission does not address or presume the claim decision.
We confirm receipt of the contractor’s invoice for CLM-044. This is an acknowledgement of the document only; the acknowledgement does not confirm cover or payment.
